gray_histo — MV gray op

• Data kinds: image2d → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.gray_histo(image, region=None, bins=256) (to call the implementation directly, import image_gray; image_gray.gray_histo(image, region=None, bins=256); from the registry, opsmv.get("gray_histo"))

• HALCON equivalent: gray_histo (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Return the gray-value histogram as absolute and relative frequencies.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

範囲は [0, 1] に固定する。範囲の外の画素があると ValueError(np.histogram は外の値を黙って捨て、8 bit の画像を渡すとほぼ空の表が返るため)。空の入力(image が 0 要素)は ValueError。
